item.title: How localized power and data centers are reshaping energy infrastructure
item.description: Jeremy Osterberger talks with Whitney Strickland, CEO of TF Companies, to discuss how data centers are driving new approaches to power generation, including onsite plants, microgrids and emerging nuclear concepts.

item.title: Dow moving forward with Canadian ethane cracker expansion
item.description: The first phase of the project, which was scheduled to start in 2027, will add about 1,285,000 metric tons of annual ethylene and PE capacity and the second phase will add about 600,000 mt/year.

item.title: bp's Whiting refinery union workers reject contract extension
item.description: The union has previously said bp proposed cutting more than 200 union jobs in operations, maintenance and environmental safety.

item.title: AIP Corp, Caterpillar and Boyd CAT form strategic alliance to power AI infrastructure
item.description: Under the purchase agreement, AIP Corp has ordered 2 GW of fast-response natural gas generator sets to support the initial phase of Monarch, with deliveries scheduled from September 2026 through August 2027.

item.title: Marathon Petroleum invests in robotic technology for tank inspections
item.description: Marathon Petroleum is entering the new year with participation in a funding round at Square Robot, Inc. - a submersible robotic tank inspection company that Marathon is currently deploying across its network of terminals and refineries.

item.title: The $60 Billion handshake: Devon and Coterra redefine the patch
item.description: The combination will create a leading large-cap shale operator with a high-quality asset base anchored by a premier position in the economic core of the Delaware Basin.

item.title: Commonwealth LNG announces 20-Year LNG sale and gas supply agreements with Mercuria
item.description: With the signing of the Mercuria SPA, Commonwealth has secured long-term, binding offtake agreements for 7 of the facility's 9.5 Mtpa permitted capacity, including commitments from prominent energy industry participants Glencore, JERA and PETRONAS.

item.title: In the West Texas oil patch, companies plan gas power plants to run new data centers
item.description: The developer of one project, in Pecos County, calls it the largest power project in the U.S.

item.title: Natural gas pipeline explodes in Cameron Parish, Louisiana
item.description: Hazmat crews are en route to the fire at the Deflin LNG pipeline.

item.title: USA DeBusk acquires Extreme Nitrogen
item.description: USA DeBusk LLC has announced it has completed the acquisition of Extreme Nitrogen LLC, a leading independent provider of nitrogen services in the United States.
